views.front: Image 1 is a 3D render of Marcus, a fictional professional middleweight boxer (not a real or famous person), standing in an A-pose. Image 2 is a close-up of his face for identity only. Redraw image 1 as a photorealistic full-body studio photograph of exactly the same man: same face, same short black hair in a clean low fade and trimmed short beard, same proportions and athletic boxer's build. He now wears his ring-walk outfit: a long, plain black satin boxing robe with bright red satin trim: a wide red shawl collar that runs down both lapels into a V at the mid chest, wide red cuff bands on the loose sleeves, which end at mid-forearm above the gloves, and a red band around the hem, which falls to just above the knees. The robe is closed, wrapped left over right and tied at the waist with a red satin belt in a simple knot. Black satin with a soft sheen and natural soft folds, no hood. Below the robe: bare lower legs, white socks and black boxing boots; red lace-up boxing gloves on both hands. No logos, stripes, patches or text anywhere on the robe. POSE IS CRITICAL, copy image 1's A-pose exactly: he stands straight facing the camera, feet shoulder-width apart, and BOTH ARMS ARE STRAIGHT AND RAISED OUT TO THE SIDES at about 45 degrees from his body, like a 3D-scanning A-pose mannequin, so there is a wide gap of empty white background between each sleeve and the robe's body and the gloves are far outside the hips at upper-thigh height. The arms must not hang down by his sides, must not be bent, and the gloves must NOT touch the robe: hands on hips is wrong. Both hands are in the boxing gloves, held as firmly closed fists. Expression: a determined, cocky smirk with the LIPS FIRMLY CLOSED AND TOGETHER: NO TEETH VISIBLE, NOT smiling or grinning; only the left corner of his mouth is pulled up slightly into a one-sided smirk, steady intense eyes looking straight into the camera. Full body visible head to feet, centered, plain white background, even soft studio lighting, photorealistic, sharp focus.
